job.title: Casualty Treaty Underwriter - Reinsurance (GI)
job.description:
Our client is a leading reinsurer in the Australasian Non-Life market and offers treaty and facultative reinsurance support for all the main classes of business including Property, Liability, Motor and Cyber. This Underwriter role sits in their Casualty & Cyber Treaty Underwriting team, which provides tailor-made reinsurance products that support clients in managing their capital and emerging risks.


The Casualty & Cyber Treaty Underwriting team specialises in the technical risk-assessment and monitoring of long-tail and cyber lines of business of the firm's reinsurance clients. The UW's provide technical support complementing the client management services, maintaining portfolio quality and execution of the team’s underwriting objectives form part of the key activities.


The team you'll be joining works in close collaboration with other local business units but as a global business, you'll also get exposure to the worldwide UW community, giving you access to underwriting experts globally.

Responsibilities;


  • Apply strong technical skills and underwriting knowledge of the exposed risks and implementing the most appropriate approach for risk assessment and pricing
  • Responsible for underwriting activities across the whole end to end process
  • Strengthen existing client relationships and develop new ones to achieve expected growth and profit contribution in conjunction with the Client Management team
  • Support new business opportunities by understanding the client’s needs and translating the risk into value
  • Support new product innovation and enhancement both within the group and with the client base
  • Identify market weaknesses and take action to provide solutions
  • Ensure data quality in underwriting platforms of allocated accounts to enable adequate reporting and monitoring activities
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of the team’s underwriting approach
  • Perform internal controls effectively, efficiently and economically
  • Develop and maintain market profile and visibility

Your Profile

  • Experience at underwriter level in reinsurance or insurer, demonstrating a good understanding of the risk exposure and appropriate methodology to assess the exposure.
  • Experience as a Casualty Treaty Underwriter is preferred but not mandatory
  • Experience in Primary market underwriting focusing on corporate, or commercial general liability or professional liability risks, plus strong foundations in RI treaty structures and pricing methodologies.
  • Strong analytical skill set.
  • Good interpersonal and effective organisational skills.
  • ANZIIF membership (preferred) or equivalent.
  • Tertiary qualification in legal studies (preferred) or equivalent.

This is a business which prides itself on its professionalism and standards and you'll work with some very supportive colleagues and gain access and exposure to local and global clients. It will be interesting work which will challenge and that must be something you are looking for in your next role. You'll need to be a team player as this is an environment where collaboration and ideas sharing is part of their culture.

If this sounds like an opportunity of interest and you have the right experience to do, please contact John Molony (john@bkcon.com.au).

job.title: General Advice Risk Adviser (Life Insurance Specialist)
job.description:
Shape how insurance advice evolves while building your income without artificial caps. You’ll work from anywhere, choosing between home or office, and benefit from paid parental leave and strong referral leads that take the pressure off sourcing your own clients.

Your commercial success will be backed by warm referrals from trusted networks, not cold digital leads. This means better client engagement and smoother conversations, giving you the chance to convert high-quality opportunities into completed policies.

With broader insurer options and a supportive team led by someone with hands-on life insurance experience, you’ll have the tools and guidance to maximise your performance. The incentive structure is designed to reward you fairly, without arbitrary limits on your earnings.

What you’ll do

Convert referred opportunities into completed life insurance policies, while ensuring clients receive clear, balanced General Advice and enough education to make informed decisions without feeling rushed or pressured.

You'll conduct outbound General Advice conversations with referred clients, explaining insurance types, product differences, and underwriting considerations. You'll provide quotes, map out next steps, and assist clients in completing applications, including medical questionnaires where required.

Manage cases through underwriting, medical requirements, and suspense, following up proactively to keep cases progressing. You'll maintain accurate advice and client records and operate within General Advice and internal compliance requirements.

What you’ll need

  • Strong sales drive and motivation to achieve commercial targets.
  • Excellent communication skills and pipeline management.
  • Ability to work autonomously and protect long-term relationships.
  • RG146

About the company

The organisation are specialists in protection. They prioritise customers over profits. They offer cover through personal, business, and employee benefits channels, ensuring customers are looked after and that they have the right cover.

If this is a role of interest, please click the ‘Apply’ button.

job.title: Life Claims - Senior Case Managers / Case Managers
job.description:
Our client is a global life insurance business, which has a long-standing presence and strong reputation in the Australian market. The business already has a large and established claims function (and support functions) and these new roles are designed to support the business, existing team and future growth.

Roles and Information:





  • Case Manager and Senior Case Managers
  • Group and Retail Teams
  • Salary range of $105K - $135K Package + Bonus
  • Hybrid working arrangements (2 or 3 days working from home)
  • Strong team culture and onboarding
  • Newly created roles across corporate & industry funds to choose from
  • Employee incentive plan and discounted insurance


Responsibilties/ Tasks:






  • Manage a portfolio of retail or group claims
  • Senior Case Managers manage a smaller portfolio of more complex and detailed claims
  • Work with empathy and understanding with claimants
  • Conduct file reviews on assessed claims for payment approvals
  • For Seniors, coach and mentor more junior claims consultants


If you have ife insurance claims experience (or potentially WC or Rehab) and want a change and to work for a growing business, then there are multiple roles. You will join teams with experienced and capable managers, and have the full support of a well-planned training and onboarding function. It's a time many are joining so you will be far from the only new starter.

If you are interested in new opportunities in life claims, please reach out to John Molony (john@bkcon.com.au).

job.title: Claims Rules and Automation Specialist
job.description:
Step beyond single-claim thinking and shape how claims are assessed at scale. This is your chance to work across the entire insurance value chain, moving from “How do I assess this claim?” to “How can claims be captured, assessed and automated across a whole system?”

You’ll help build a claims automation solution that sets the standard for future implementations. With a clear path to influence how technology transforms claims lodgement, assessment and decision-making, you’ll demonstrate strategic and commercial capabilities that are rare to develop in traditional claims roles.

Claims has long seen less tech investment than other areas of insurance. That’s changing fast. You’ll work on a live automation project that improves efficiency, scalability and customer outcomes - and lays the groundwork for broader future innovation, including AI-driven medical assessments and automated IP evaluations.

You’ll have the option for hybrid work in Sydney, or full-time remote if you’re based in NSW. On top of that, you’ll get five weeks’ annual leave, Income Protection insurance, and financial support for gym memberships and private health insurance.

What you’ll do

Initially, you’ll support the delivery of a claims automation solution for a key client, helping to strengthen the underlying claims rule set and prepare the proposition for wider use. This will give you hands-on experience with cutting-edge claims technology and the chance to shape its future direction.

Longer term, you’ll help demonstrate what claims automation can achieve and contribute to a proposition that has significant potential if delivered well. You’ll also build a stronger claims automation foundation, so future implementations don’t have to start from scratch.

What you’ll need

  • Experience in Australian life insurance claims
  • Experience mapping claims processes or participating in claims-related transformation or technology projects

About the company

This is a global organisation focused on innovation and collaboration. They’ve been steadily growing and investing in tools that make claims more efficient, giving you the chance to work with the latest systems and practices. They’re pushing the boundaries in what claims automation can achieve.

Please click the ‘Apply’ button.
